# nlohmann/json 3.10.5

Single-header JSON library used to read the simulation input files
(`projects/geometric-flow/src/SimConfig.cpp`). Copied unchanged from the
Ubuntu package `nlohmann-json3-dev` (3.10.5). MIT licensed; the license is at
the top of `include/nlohmann/json.hpp`. Upstream: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
